intent_record.intent_summary: Force synchronous decompression in atomic contexts when the decompression mode is set to auto to ensure safe and correct execution.
intent_record.what: Adds a conditional check within the atomic context block of `z_erofs_decompress_kickoff` to update `sbi->sync_decompress` from `EROFS_SYNC_DECOMPRESS_AUTO` to `EROFS_SYNC_DECOMPRESS_FORCE_ON`.
intent_record.how: This forces the decompression path to run synchronously when triggered from an atomic context if the decompression policy is set to auto, avoiding asynchronous worker scheduling in restricted contexts.

intent_record.intent_summary: Prevent sync_decompress from being incorrectly overridden to FORCE_ON when configured as AUTO.
intent_record.what: Removed the conditional check and assignment that changed sbi->sync_decompress from EROFS_SYNC_DECOMPRESS_AUTO to EROFS_SYNC_DECOMPRESS_FORCE_ON.
intent_record.how: Stops the system from permanently forcing synchronous decompression once an asynchronous path is triggered, preserving the dynamic AUTO state.
